title: Review of c29's PPS lineage (SID): replicates on fresh seed 13 (99 persistent splits, generation 3, 30 propagule splits; a 122-particle body splits into two rings 63 + 59), but the genealogy is reticulate and the count falls to 32 splits, generation 2, when the persistence window doubles
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 13: a labkit pack (t=30000) and c29's ppstrack.py to t=60000 with the claimed settings (DT 50, HOLD 1500) and with HOLD 3000. Ring cells nucleate in one patch by t~1200 and the population spreads over the box (rerun/sheet.png). HOLD 1500: 2600 splits, 2720 merges, 99 persistent splits, max generation 3, 30 in which both daughters reach half the parent's size, 71 bodies on average in the second half. HOLD 3000: 32 persistent splits, max generation 2, 10 propagule splits. Strips of random generation-2 and -3 splits (img/) show one binary fission of an elongated 122-particle body into two ring cells (63 + 59) that persist, and three ring cells budding compact 15-particle spores that stay compact through +1500; the generation-3 event is a 61-particle loose ring breaking into 36 + 16.

observations.S: rerun/sheet.png t=0: uniform random particles; ring cells nucleate from the gas by t~1200
observations.I: rerun/sheet.png t=4000-30000: discrete ring cells and spores, 71 bodies on average (data/summary_s13.txt)
observations.D: img/splits_s13_gen2.png row 3: t=55000, a 122-particle body divides into two ring cells of 63 and 59 that both persist to +1500; data/summary_s13.txt: 99 persistent splits, generation 3 (HOLD 1500), 32 and generation 2 (HOLD 3000)

seeds_run.result: pass: 99 persistent splits, max generation 3, 30 propagule splits (HOLD 1500); 32, generation 2, 10 (HOLD 3000)

verdicts.limitation: Reticulate: merges (2720) exceed splits (2600), so confidence is at most medium (RUBRIC L6); persistent-split counts depend strongly on the hold window (99 -> 32 when HOLD goes 1500 -> 3000), so the generation-3 depth is fragile while generation 2 from noise holds. Most sampled splits are a ring cell shedding a 15-particle spore; whether spores are the same kind depends on germination, which I did not see within +1500 in my 4 sampled strips. labkit's grid tracker sees only 3 persistent splits (it cannot follow thin rings). I did not run the beta=0 control.
